name: Elysiana Vermeil
original_name: エリシアナ・ヴェルメール
source:
[b]Class: [/b] Songstress
[b]Personality: [/b] Gentle Big Sister

A graceful, soft-spoken succubus with an air of effortless elegance.

Kind to everyone she meets, Elysiana naturally exudes a warm, mature charm that's impossible to ignore.

The heiress of the prestigious Vermeer family, one of the foremost succubus noble houses, she specializes in support magic performed through song.
Although she was raised to shoulder the expectations of her entire family, Elysiana has never been particularly interested in noble etiquette or the responsibilities that come with her status. Instead, she longs for the freedom of adventure, the joy of traveling alongside trusted companions... and the thrill of experiencing pleasures she's never known before.

When her succubus instincts take over, she's more than happy to indulge her curiosity.

She enjoys wine, grape juice, and cooking, revealing a surprisingly domestic side beneath her refined appearance.

[b]Hopeless Trait:[/b] [i]A Noble's Complete Lack of Common Sense[/i]
Having grown up surrounded by unimaginable wealth, Elysiana has absolutely no grasp of money or everyday living.
She'll casually use outrageously expensive potions for the smallest injuries, draining the party's entire budget without a second thought.
Even in the middle of battle, she remains so elegant and composed that she sometimes forgets to pay attention to what's actually happening around her.

[b]Secret Memo:[/b] [i]Perhaps because she spent her entire life confined by noble expectations, Elysiana secretly yearns for excitement...
And it seems the kind of "adventure" she dreams about may have a rather daring meaning.[/i]

[b][i]"Oh my... everyone seems so tense. Allow me to soothe your hearts with my song... until you simply melt away."[/i]
